name: manageStationGroupAppAssignment
description: Updates a specific app assignment for a station group. Corresponds to PUT /api/stations/v1/station-groups/{stationGroupId}/app-assignments/{appAssignmentId}. Requires `stations:write` scope. [WRITE]

stationGroupId.description: The id of the station group to update.

appAssignmentId.description: The id of the app assignment to update.

tag.description: Which app version runs: the development version or the latest published one.

appId.description: App ID (type app, and type app-version).
